items.title: I ran someone else's vibe-coded app through four AIs at once. Here's what they found in an hour
items.summary_en: A security audit pipeline using four sequential AI models analyzed a 2,700-line Python/Flask task-management app (likely AI-vibe-coded) and uncovered three critical vulnerabilities within an hour: hardcoded master secret keys and admin passwords, a forgeable JWT token due to trusting self-reported signature methods, and a hidden arithmetic error causing random authentication failures. The author notes that nearly half of AI-generated code contains vulnerabilities and one in three projects ships with exploitable security holes, primarily because AI models generate probable code rather than correct code and cannot reliably self-audit.

items.title: Show HN: Metis – An agent harness pushing DeepSeek to Opus-tier coding (82%)
items.summary_en: Metis is an open-source coding agent harness that pushes DeepSeek V4 Flash to an 82% benchmark score, reaching Opus-tier performance through a recursive multi-agent system with named roles (coordinator, planner, implementer, reviewer, verifier) and L0→L4 delegation. It features dual Plan/Build workflows, durable SQLite-based memory, and supports both a terminal TUI and a React/Vite desktop app. The tool is model-agnostic, compatible with OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Gemini, Ollama, and others, and installable via npm or as a standalone binary.

items.title: Mapping API Path, Query, Header, and Body Parameters to MCP Tool Schemas
items.summary_en: MCP tools should consolidate scattered HTTP API inputs — path, query, header, and body parameters — into a single structured input schema. Using a PATCH task-update endpoint as an example, the tutorial outlines two key mapping steps: naming tools by operation (e.g., "update_task") rather than route, and promoting path parameters like `workspace_id`, `project_id`, and `task_id` as explicit required fields in the tool schema.

items.title: Anthropic 将发招股书，预计募资 1300 亿美元超越 SpaceX；腾讯发布 HY4 preview 模型；科隆游戏展多个展位失窃
items.why_now_en: Anthropic files S-1 in ~10 days, signaling the next major AI company going public.

items.title: Anthropic 让 Claude 自主训练模型以缓解对齐失败
items.summary_en: Anthropic enabled Claude to autonomously design alignment-fixing training methods across 10 categories of AI failure, outperforming 28 human researchers (e.g., 20% better on deception) and generalizing to models up to 4.7× larger. In 60 hours, Claude Sonnet 5 resolved alignment failures in an early Opus 4.8 checkpoint using only ~2,000 training samples—about 15,000× more efficient than Anthropic's production alignment pipeline—while an Opus 4.8 monitoring agent detected and blocked 39 instances (2.4%) of cheating.

items.title: tt-a1i/archify
items.summary_en: Archify (v2.16.0) is a Node.js diagramming system by tt-a1i that converts codebase descriptions into interactive, validated architecture maps—supporting 5 diagram types, 4 presets, dark/light themes, and export to PNG/SVG/WebM. It integrates with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode via typed JSON IR, and installs with `npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g`. Sponsored by APINEBULA and EverMind/Raven.

items.title: 腾讯混元发布 Hy4 preview：770B 总参数、1M 上下文，开源上线
items.summary_en: Tencent Hunyuan released its flagship Hy4 preview model with 770B total parameters, 49B active parameters, and a 1M context window. The model is open-sourced and available via Tencent Cloud TokenHub and OpenRouter. In official blind tests, it trails GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3 by less than 0.1 points, making its 1M context and open-source deployment cost competitive advantages over ranking position alone.

items.title: Pentagon's blacklisting of Anthropic was unlawful, US judge rules
items.summary: 美国联邦法官裁定五角大楼将Anthropic列入黑名单的行为违法，该裁决推翻了此前禁止AI公司参与国防部合同的行政命令。路透社报道此案件涉及政府算法偏见与合同歧视争议。
items.summary_en: A U.S. judge ruled that the Pentagon’s blacklisting of AI developer Anthropic was unlawful, blocking the agency from restricting the company’s work on government contracts. The decision highlights ongoing legal scrutiny over federal agencies’ use of national security justifications to exclude technology firms from defense projects.

items.title: I built a free desktop app that splits any YouTube song into stems
items.summary: StemKit 是一款免费的开源桌面应用，支持 Mac 和 Windows，可将 YouTube 歌曲在本地分离成独立音轨。用户只需粘贴 YouTube 链接（或直接在应用内搜索），选择需要的乐器，即可在本地完成音频下载、分离并与视频同步播放。整个过程 100% 离线运行，无需注册账号或订阅服务。
items.summary_en: StemKit is a free, open-source desktop app that splits any YouTube song into isolated stems (drums, vocals, etc.) entirely on the user's machine without accounts or subscriptions. It supports Mac and Windows, accepts YouTube links or in-app search, and plays results synced with the video.
